prompt.label: KDP colorize
lines: Colorize the selected KDP black-and-white coloring page as a polished back-cover or store thumbnail.
Preserve the exact black-and-white line art, characters, composition, clean outlines, facial expressions, and object placement.
Keep the result family-friendly, bright, readable at thumbnail size, and suitable for KDP product imagery.
Do not add text, logos, borders, watermarks, new characters, extra animals, speech bubbles, page numbers, or decorative typography.
Do not crop, reframe, erase line art, redraw faces, change character count, or convert the image into a photoreal scene.
